grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, honey, sugar, oats, peaches and almonds are all plain home cupboard foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including flaked almonds and June peaches, is an everyday Tesco item.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a pan and a square tin, and the melt, press and bake method is beginner level.

works.reason: The 250g oats to 150g butter and honey-sugar mix binds well, and 30 to 35 minutes at 180°C suits a 20cm tin, giving 12 bars that will be softer in the fruit layer but will hold once cooled.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers melting, stirring, stoning and slicing three peaches, and the 35 minute cook matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears, and flaked almonds are simply almonds.

seasonal_feel.reason: A layer of ripe peaches through a teatime traybake suits mid-June, and the peaches are the point of it.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English a neighbour would give.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, fruit and nuts make this a satisfying afternoon snack, with moderate sugar for a flapjack.
